title: Lord Inquisitor Seru
summary: Lord Inquisitor Seru remains bound to the time chamber.
overview: Lord Inquisitor Seru remains bound to the time chamber.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Position the raid inside the chamber and maintain control when he returns to its center.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: During combat, the script checks the chamber boundary every second.
If he leaves the allowed rectangle, Seru moves back to the chamber center.
The script does not define a separate health-phase or wave sequence.
